Data:Knife.json.label: Knife
Data:Knife.json.desc: 'This is the line of division.' - Wolfe

Data:Knife.thirza.json.Label: Bronze Knife
Data:Knife.thirza.json.Desc: A long knife of age-darkened metal with a teak handle inlaid with bone. It could be a hunting knife, although it's certainly no older than the nineteenth century, and it's not clear why anyone might have chosen to make a hunting knife out of bronze in the nineteenth century.

xexts.scrutiny: The tang is engraved with the letters T.B. The bone has absorbed a dark stain that might be old blood. Or it might be old strawberries.

Data:Knock.json.label: Knock
Data:Knock.json.desc: The principle called Knock permits no seal and no isolation. It thrusts us gleefully out of the safety of ignorance. [Knock opens doors and unseams barriers.]

Data:Knock.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Knock.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Kod.json.label: UNRELEAS'D
Data:Kod.json.desc: Something is needed here that none of us have. [This marks material that will only be available or completed later; not in this early version.]

xexts.scrutiny: An inscription on the pediment reads 'The Gods-from-steel did not exist.'
The base is  unexpectedly heavy. Obsidian?

Data:Lamp.hurricane.json.Label: Hurricane Lamp
Data:Lamp.hurricane.json.Desc: Proof against storm-wind and moth-swoop alike.

Data:Lamp.moth.json.Label: Compelling Lamp
Data:Lamp.moth.json.Desc: Moths circle it like maypole dancers.

xexts.scrutiny: Gaze on the light, and for a little while set thoughts aside…

Data:Lamp.revelation.json.Label: Reading Lamp
Data:Lamp.revelation.json.Desc: To ensure clarity of vision even in utmost dark. It does flicker occasionally.

xexts.scrutiny: A gift from Governor Collers - apparently, for once, without any ulterior motive.

Data:Lamp.table.edge.json.Label: Strategist's Lamp
Data:Lamp.table.edge.json.Desc: Purchased by Governor Collers from a complicated general after the Great War.

xexts.scrutiny: In certain obscure contexts, the Great War is referred to as the 'Second Worm War'. But the Suppression Bureau discourages - suppresses, in fact - use of that term.

Data:Lamp.table.grail.json.Label: Cyprian's Lamp
Data:Lamp.table.grail.json.Desc: A curio brought back from one of Serena Blackwood's trips to Greece.

xexts.scrutiny: On the base is scratched SERENA. FOR THE BAY AT SUNSET. XX
Once used to map journeys across secret charts…

Data:Lantern.json.label: Lantern
Data:Lantern.json.desc: 'Life is a pure flame, and we live by an invisible Sun within us.' - Thomas Browne. [Lantern is the principle of the secret place sometimes called the House of the Sun, and of the light above it.]

Data:Lantern.only.hint.json.label: Now What?
Data:Lantern.only.hint.json.startdescription: There's potential here. [Start by adding a Soul card.]

Data:Lapsang.sweetened.cup.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Lapsang (Cup)
Data:Lapsang.sweetened.cup.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.

Data:Lapsang.sweetened.h.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Lapsang (Half-Pot)
Data:Lapsang.sweetened.h.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.

Data:Lapsang.sweetened.json.Label: Deep-Sweetened Lapsang (Pot)
Data:Lapsang.sweetened.json.Desc: Sweetened with agave syrup and deep history.

xexts.scrutiny: An undulating bundle of possibilities… [Certain Scholar-level recipes will hatch this from an Egg in the presence of sufficient Moth - or sometimes Moon.]

Data:Leathy.json.Label: Leathy
Data:Leathy.json.Desc: A dark and syrupy liquor favoured in unnamed forest villages.

xexts.scrutiny: 'The tongue and the eye, and now we begin! Forget your name, forget your skin.' [There are Scholar-level Nectar - occasionally, Moon - recipes that will create this from another beverage.]

Data:Leathy.lees.json.Label: Leathy Lees
Data:Leathy.lees.json.Desc: The dark aftermath of a dark drink.

Data:Leek.gratin.json.Label: Leek Gratin
Data:Leek.gratin.json.Desc: Harvey Hattington, who established a surprisingly persistent influence on the kitchens of Hush House during his short stay here, described leek as 'Onion's Empress.'

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.cho.json.label: What Remains of Me? Instinct?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.cho.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Exuberance, enthusiasm, instinct all rise from that part of the soul we call chor. Is my chor strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.cho.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. It wasn't easy to come here... but I don't give up easily. Even so, I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.cho.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.ereb.json.label: What Remains of Me? Passion?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.ereb.json.startdescription: Ereb is the shadow in the soul's cellar: pride, fear, hatred, compassion. [Choose a strong ereb, and a past where your passions were paramount. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.ereb.json.desc:
I wanted something I didn't have. I don't have very much at all now, do I? I suppose that should make it easier.

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

[Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.ereb.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.fet.json.label: What Remains of Me? Dreams?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.fet.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Fet is that part of the soul that dreams. Is my fet strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.fet.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. I've seen it in my dreams, night after night. I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.fet.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.mettle.json.label: What Remains of Me? My strength of character?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.mettle.json.startdescription: Mettle is the soul's tempering - will; self-discipline; that part of us which makes the right choice. [Choose a strong mettle, and a past where you made mistakes. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.mettle.json.desc:
Perhaps here I can atone for all I've done. But what was that, exactly?

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

[Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.phost.json.label: What Remains of Me? Light?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.phost.json.startdescription: Phost is the light within: sight, perception, inspiration. [Choose a strong phost, and a past with a pursuer who can see the light within you. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.phost.json.desc:
Perhaps here I'll find safety from what follows me. But what was that, exactly?

First things first. I remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there.

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.shapt.json.label: What Remains of Me? Words?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.shapt.json.startdescription: The human soul has nine parts. Eloquence and understanding rise from that part of the soul we call shapt. Is my shapt strong? [Recover this. The other two possibilities will be lost to the sea... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.shapt.json.desc: This is the coast where Brancrug Isle lies. My sources briefed me thoroughly about the place, and I know there's no way I can cross to the isle in these seas. I'll need to find shelter for the night.
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.shapt.json.comments: extra purges below are for backwards compatibility

Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.wist.json.label: What Remains of Me? Knowledge?
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.wist.json.startdescription: Wist is the soul's memory, the true name scratched on its cornerstone, what remains after the rest has passed. [Choose a strong wist, and a past where you sought voices that had fallen silent. The waves will wash away the others... for now.]
Data:Legacy.setup.librarian.wist.json.desc: There are still things I don't remember. But I do remember there's someone in the village who will give me sanctuary - if I can get there. [Mysteries have been added to your Journal. You can begin to investigate them when you and your journal are both dry.]

Data:Leiter.agdistis.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I pity the Cross, and I hope they may persist, out beyond the skies where the Stars are not too hungry. But the Cross-nature is a sickness. When those it troubles come to me, I heal them.'

Data:Leiter.agdistis.foe.nowhere.json.desc: 'I will not accept that everything must end. Perhaps that makes me Eternity's fool. But certainly it makes me Nowhere's enemy. I have trusted too easily; I have seen how Worms work within, and I have devised methods to extirpate them - not kind methods, but necessary.'

Data:Leiter.agdistis.json.desc: Agdistis' ideals were not reflected in the Institute's founding principles. He is not an enthusiastic Secretary Salvant; but he is a dutiful one, employing his healing arts as the Institute directs.

Data:Leiter.agdistis.mission.secrecy.jso.desc: 'We knew that peace would not be possible. Berlin is gone; Europe is lost; the West and the East are strange gold and stranger steel. But our caution has kept us almost unscathed. We will wait beneath the tramplings of the great like the cicada beneath the leaf. When it ends, we will endure.'

Data:Leiter.agdistis.mission.stone.remem.desc: 'The gods-from-Stone knew healing arts we had forgotten - still locked in the tangled roots of our cells like the script on the Serpent-root. I have employed the Institute's resources to unlock those secrets. I hope that was wise.'

Data:Leiter.aladim.foe.carapace.json.desc: 'I had always thought we could not trust the Carapace-kinds. I take no pleasure in being proved right. Locust; scorpion; wasp. Where I find them, I crush them.'

Data:Leiter.aladim.foe.devourers.json.desc: 'With so many uncounted Hours, the Mansus-dwellers go ungoverned… although fortunately, many of them are missing too. I have co-ordinated with the Duties, across Europe and beyond… and the nights have become a little less lively.'
